# Meet — P2P video meeting

Anonymous, room-code-based, peer-to-peer (WebRTC) video meeting.

## Architecture
- `frontend/` — static site (Vite + TS), built to `docs/` at repo root, served via GitHub Pages at `meet.itsash.in`. Landing page creates/joins a 4-character room code (`meet.itsash.in/xxxx`). Client-side signaling protocol/state machine runs in a Rust→WASM module (`frontend/wasm-signal/`, built with `wasm-pack`, output copied into `frontend/src/wasm/` — gitignored, regenerated by `make build`). Actual audio/video uses native browser WebRTC (`RTCPeerConnection`), STUN-only, no TURN.
- `worker/` — Cloudflare Worker + one Durable Object per room (`RoomSignal`), deployed to `meet-signal.its-ash.workers.dev`. Purely a WebSocket relay for SDP/ICE between exactly two peers. No media ever touches this Worker.
  - **Session lifecycle**: each connected socket must send `{"type":"ping"}` at least every 2s (client does this via `HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS` in `frontend/src/call.ts`). A recurring DO alarm sweeps every 2s and closes (code 4000) any socket whose last ping is ≥5s old — this is the *only* timeout mechanism now (no separate one-shot "5s to pair" alarm). Per-socket last-ping timestamps are stored via `ws.serializeAttachment()`, which survives DO hibernation.
  - When one peer disconnects, the survivor's socket is **not** closed — it receives a live `{"type":"peer-left"}` message and the client transitions back to `WaitingForPeer` (fresh 5s client-side "waiting for partner" countdown, separate concept from the server's per-socket heartbeat timeout).
  - A 3rd visitor to a full room is rejected with HTTP 409 at the WebSocket upgrade (`fetch()` in `room.ts`); the client avoids ever hitting this by calling `GET /room-status/:roomId` first (see `worker/src/index.ts`) and showing a "meeting is full" view if `count >= 2`.

## Conventions
- Root `Makefile`: `run` / `build` / `deploy` only, coordinating both sub-projects (see Makefile itself).
- `docs/` at repo root is the GitHub Pages publish directory — regenerated by `make build`, committed on deploy. GitHub Pages is configured manually in repo settings (Pages → deploy from `docs/` on `main`); no GitHub Actions deploy workflow.
- `frontend/src/wasm/` is build output (gitignored) — never hand-edit, regenerate via `wasm-pack build --target web` from `frontend/wasm-signal/`.
- Both `frontend/` and `worker/` are independent Node projects with their own `package.json`; `worker/wrangler.jsonc` binds the `RoomSignal` Durable Object and deploys to the default `meet-signal.its-ash.workers.dev` subdomain.
